lcc_original: 該南生瑪勒列之後，又活了八百四十年，這期間還生兒養女。
notes: UNV 並且生 → LCC 這期間還生: LCC expands the conjunction into a full temporal phrase (這期間還). Only 生 carries SNs; 這期間 and 還 are LCC elaboration with no Hebrew equivalents.
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit: LCC also has no explicit direct object marker word for Hebrew אֵת, so braces are preserved.

First <WH08141> (construct שָׁנָה in 八百_年 compound): kept floating between 百<WH03967> and 四十<WH0705> as in UNV, since LCC likewise has no explicit word for this construct instance. Second <WH08141> attaches to 年.

Both morphology codes (WTH8687 on first 生, WTH8686 on second 生) preserved attached to their respective verb occurrences — UNV distinguishes Hiphil perfect vs. Hiphil imperfect for the two begetting clauses.
